Cubic derivative has one positive maximizer for c<2, continuous at threshold; higher-degree origin remains locally strict and maximizing off-center radii converge to positive R_m. Singular value of the finite Hankel reversal-plus-corner matrix gives the stated full operator norm. Exact finite algebraic comparison with the earlier general n=1 binomial threshold and radii passed for m=4..15. Infinite m conclusion follows from derivatives, not finite checks.
